f01.text: Just landed in Australia on a working holiday visa?

f02.text: Sort these three things before your first shift.

f03.text: One. Get a Tax File Number.

f04.text: It's free, online, about twenty minutes,

f05.text: and you apply once you're in Australia.

f06.text: No TFN? Tax comes out at the top rate.

f07.text: Two. Ask if your employer is registered for working holiday makers.

f08b.text: on your first forty-five thousand dollars.

f09.text: Three. Super. Your employer must pay twelve percent on top of your wages,

f11.text: Keep your fund details: you can claim it after you leave Australia.

f13.text: Save this for your first week.
